posts.body:
I've always used Tesco's own brand nappies and never had any complaints, but is it just me or since the re brand of Tesco's nappies they are now rubbish, my toddler is permanently wet through.

Time to change brands I think .:mad:

I might be complety wrong but since huggies are no longer making them in the UK its possible that tescos 'own brand' was made in a huggies factory so they would of had to find a new suppiler...
